hospital.name: Shubh Arogya Institute of Medical Sciences

bio: Urologist offering robotic prostate surgery and laser stone treatment.

inclusions: Operation theatre charges and standard consumables
Nursing care and routine medicines during the stay
Pre-procedure tests listed in the treatment plan
Review consultation before you fly home
exclusions: Treatment of unrelated or pre-existing conditions
Extended ICU stay or care for complications beyond the plan
Accommodation outside the hospital (see the Medical + Stay package)

packages.name: Medical Only
packages.description: Treatment as per the hospital plan: 2-night hospital stay, procedure and doctor fees and standard medicines. Travel and accommodation arranged separately.

packages.name: Medical + Stay
packages.description: Everything in Medical Only, plus 5 nights at a serviced apartment near the hospital and airport pickup and drop.

packages.name: All-Inclusive
packages.description: Everything in Medical + Stay, plus a medical interpreter, daily meals, local transport for appointments and 3 follow-up video consultations after you return home.
